mechanism: Mycophenolate is renally cleared and zoledronic acid can cause acute kidney injury, potentially increasing mycophenolate exposure and toxicity; additionally, both drugs may increase infection risk in immunocompromised patients.
action: Monitor renal function closely before and after zoledronic acid infusion; consider dose adjustment of mycophenolate if creatinine clearance declines; ensure adequate hydration and monitor for signs of infection.
